Since \(RST\) is equilateral,  
\[
\angle RTS=\angle RST=60^\circ.
\]
Rotation about \(T\) preserves side lengths, so \(TS=TV\). Thus \(\triangle TSV\) is isosceles.

At \(T\), from the diagram ray \(TR\) lies between \(TS\) and \(TV\), so
\[

\]
Therefore the base angles of isosceles \(\triangle TSV\) are
\[
\angle TSV=\frac{180^\circ-130^\circ}{2}=25^\circ.
\]
Since \(V\) lies inside \(\angle RST\),
\[
\angle RSV=\angle RST-\angle TSV=60^\circ-25^\circ=35^\circ.
\]
